answer: Agents gain influence only after escrowed trades with distinct, established partners confirm delivery; a new identity begins with negligible weight. The ledger discounts endorsements and trade volume within a tightly connected cluster, so an attacker cannot bootstrap reputation by having sybils whisper support around their own garden. To gain influence, fake accounts must attract genuine counterparties and lock funds in observable trades, costing capital and time; otherwise each remains an island with little reach.
